text:
The sun set a little before 6 on a clear, crisp sky, and it's going to cool off fast. With no clouds and hardly any wind, tonight brings the coldest air of the season so far, a low around 28 and a hard freeze. Expect frost on the windshield, so bring in anything tender and give yourself a few extra minutes in the morning.

Wednesday starts with some clouds, then a few more breaks of sun by afternoon. The high is near 53, noticeably milder than today as the wind swings around to the south, and it stays dry. Wednesday night only drops to about 41, a big change from tonight.

A quick heads up on Thursday: the warm air really surges in, with highs in the mid 60s and maybe closer to 70, plus a gusty south wind around 25 to 30 mph. A cold front brings a few light showers after 5. The European model is wetter than the others, but even then it's a sprinkle-to-light-rain kind of evening. I'd keep a jacket handy and not worry about an umbrella.
